acceptance_criteria.description: The iteration policy is documented and referenced by the LLM entry guide.
The schema and synthetic checkpoint example validate locally.
Live provider behavior follows the new policy.

effective_patterns.pattern: Keep a known-good archive, make a bounded change, and test the newly affected contract plus adjacent regression surfaces.
replication_conditions: The base archive is identified and checksummed.
The change has an explicit acceptance scope.
Clean extraction and documented tests are run after packaging.
effective_patterns.limits: Local package validation does not prove live LLM adherence or production safety.

failure_prevention.failure_pattern: Version references and CLI defaults can remain pinned to a previous release.
failure_prevention.prevention_or_detection: Update current-version references in docs, config, validator defaults, and tests together.
failure_prevention.verification: Search the extracted release for stale current-version markers and run the CLI default-version test.

unknowns: Live user/LLM collaboration outcomes and long-term cognitive influence have not been evaluated by this synthetic example.

next_step.proposal: A future live-adapter evaluation could test whether the new review loop preserves conversational freedom without causing excessive reviews.

notes: Synthetic example only; it is not a claim that this package has passed a live provider evaluation.
